answer: A witness plume stops fakes: each job above five units needs a plume of three witnesses who saw it, each sealed in umber by the client. Two random peers confirm them within 48 hours, countersigned by the client. A forged witness, a reused mark, or one witness vouching twice drops the claimant to its nadir and burns a 19-unit bond. Honest agents pass once their witnesses speak; 100 fakes need 300 witnesses and 100 clients, risking 1,900 units.
